# OpenIE Research

> Research studies by David Charlot at Open Interface Engineering, Inc. The thesis is that energy to run is the only true metric of computer intelligence. Each study has a web edition and a PDF. Energy figures are labeled as estimates unless a named meter measured them.

The catalog holds five research studies, one economic opinion, and one research track. Mixture of Limits is the philosophy. Metabolic Intelligence is the AI product class, and its product home is Klere (klere.ai), which builds the Energy Processing Unit (EPU). The Universal Law of Agency orders the work: law first, kinematics second, and intelligence as the calculus of agency in joules.

## Studies

- [Mixture of Limits: Navigation Law for Computer Intelligence](https://research.openie.dev/papers/mol/): Research study. Mixture of Limits is the philosophy. It names floors past which more tokens, parameters, or joules stop buying verifiable progress on a task. Compression into predictive formulas beats excess enumeration. The neural network is a residual leaf, off by default. The reference path runs in software, and its energy figures are labeled estimates. [PDF](https://research.openie.dev/pdfs/mol.pdf)
- [Notational Intelligence as Commit Law](https://research.openie.dev/papers/ni/): Research study. Notational Intelligence treats permission to act as a formal object. A proposal may not authorize itself. The software reference, Wise Computer Automation (WCA), commits or refuses at irreversible actions and records each decision under a fixed schema. Energy is analytical accounting, not board power. [PDF](https://research.openie.dev/pdfs/ni.pdf)
- [Satiation and Scarcity after Free AI](https://research.openie.dev/papers/satiation/): Research study. Satiation defines when a loop of work or care is done. Once a stated completeness test holds, further calls add no value, and calls that undo it are harm. Falling inference prices do not mean free energy, free actuation, or unbounded value after a chore is complete. [PDF](https://research.openie.dev/pdfs/satiation.pdf)
- [Metabolic Intelligence: Budget-Native Compute from Tag to Campus](https://research.openie.dev/papers/mei/): Research study. Metabolic Intelligence is the AI product class. A fixed energy budget is the physical condition of the best answer, not a cheaper one. Work that would break the budget is refused or deferred. It spans coin-cell tags at the edge to a resource-optimized central datacenter. It runs on any compute fabric, and its product home is Klere (klere.ai), the maker of the Energy Processing Unit (EPU). [PDF](https://research.openie.dev/pdfs/mei.pdf)
- [The Search for JouleOS](https://research.openie.dev/papers/jouleos/): Research study (review and design guide). Existing compute fabric treats the floor as fixed, and agents are wrapped on top of it. Energy to run is not yet the condition of a commit. Secure compute requires one law, one meter, and one refusal. That requirement is the search for a design like JouleOS, built on one intent stream and a WebAssembly runtime. [PDF](https://research.openie.dev/pdfs/jouleos.pdf)
- [Spell Check is Global : The Future of Computer Intelligence in the hands of the many (7B+) and not the few (under 500M)](https://research.openie.dev/papers/spellcheck/): Economic opinion. People used to pay a premium for spell check. Now it is free and bundled into the editor, the browser, and the phone. That is what happens when technology is built for global access, for more than 7 billion people, instead of priced by scarcity for fewer than 500 million. Energy to run is what remains. [PDF](https://research.openie.dev/pdfs/spellcheck.pdf)
- [The Universal Law of Agency](https://research.openie.dev/papers/agency/): Research track. Law first, kinematics second. Nothing is an agent until the Universal Law of Agency is met. The kinematic laws bound how fast agency moves per joule. Intelligence is the calculus of agency: a derivative read in hindsight off a completed run, written as iota = dX/dJ. Energy to run is the only true metric of computer intelligence. [PDF](https://research.openie.dev/pdfs/agency.pdf)

## Reference

- [Glossary](https://research.openie.dev/glossary/): Shared terms across the studies, including value of information, evidence classes, and soft-ref.
- [About the studies](https://research.openie.dev/about/): One page per study on what it claims and what it does not.
- [Figures](https://research.openie.dev/living/): Interactive figures for the studies.
